lootr.configuration.blast_immune.tooltip: Lootr containers cannot be destroyed by any explosion.
lootr.configuration.blast_resistant.tool: Lootr containers cannot be destroyed by creeper or TNT explosions.
lootr.configuration.break_to_drop_loot.t: Breaking a Lootr container without sneaking drops the player's loot and marks the container as opened instead of destroying it.
lootr.configuration.brushables_self_supp: Suspicious Lootr blocks do not fall when the block below them is removed.
lootr.configuration.bypass_spawn_protect: If enabled, Lootr containers can be opened inside the spawn protection area.
lootr.configuration.check_world_border.t: Ignore containers and chunks outside the world border. Enable this if you use a world border and have TPS problems; restart the client after changing the border.
lootr.configuration.conversion.tooltip: Options for converting containers into Lootr containers.
lootr.configuration.convert_elytras_to_c: Convert Elytra Item Frames into Chests
Whether the elytra item frame of an End ship is converted into a loot chest with a guaranteed elytra.
lootr.configuration.convert_elytras_to_i: Convert Elytra Item Frames into Lootr Item Frames
Whether the elytra item frame of an End ship is converted into a Lootr item frame holding the elytra.
Whether item frames with items that structures generate are converted into Lootr item frames.
lootr.configuration.convert_mineshafts.t: Whether chest minecarts in mineshafts are converted (deprecated).
lootr.configuration.debug_log.tooltip: Log one line per extended loot roll.
lootr.configuration.decay.tooltip: Options for containers that decay after being opened.
lootr.configuration.decay_all.tooltip: All containers decay after they were opened for the first time, whatever the three lists say.
lootr.configuration.decay_dimensions.too: Containers in these dimensions decay. Example: minecraft:the_nether
lootr.configuration.decay_loot_tables.to: Containers with these loot tables decay. Example: modid:chests/loot_table
lootr.configuration.decay_modids.tooltip: Containers with loot tables of these mod IDs decay. Example: othermod
lootr.configuration.decay_particles.tool: Containers that are going to decay emit particles.
lootr.configuration.decay_value.tooltip: Ticks a decaying container takes to decay (default: 5 minutes).
Containers are not converted in these dimensions. Example: minecraft:the_end
Containers are only converted in these dimensions. Empty: all dimensions. Example: minecraft:overworld
lootr.configuration.disable.tooltip: If enabled, no containers are converted.
lootr.configuration.disable_break.toolti: Lootr containers cannot be broken, except while sneaking in creative mode.
lootr.configuration.disable_message_styl: Disable Style And Formatting In Notifications
Send break, decay and refresh messages without colours and formatting.
lootr.configuration.disable_notification: Do not show notifications about decaying or refreshed containers.
lootr.configuration.display_toasts.toolt: Show decay and refresh notifications as toasts. If disabled, they appear as on-screen messages.
lootr.configuration.enable_break.tooltip: Lootr containers can be broken without sneaking. Overrides 'Disable Break'.
lootr.configuration.enable_fake_player_b: Fake players (machines of other mods) can break Lootr containers without sneaking, even if breaking is disabled.
lootr.configuration.enabled: Add Loot From Other Loot Tables
lootr.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Add a few stacks from other loot tables to the container loot tables selected by data pack rules.
lootr.configuration.extra_banned_items.t: Additional banned items: item IDs (modid:item) or item tags (#modid:tag).
lootr.configuration.filter_all_loot: Remove Banned Items From All Loot Tables
lootr.configuration.filter_all_loot.tool: Remove banned items from every loot table roll. If disabled, only from Lootr's own containers.
lootr.configuration.imported_loot_integr: Set once the settings of lootintegrations.json have been taken over. Disable it to take them over again at the next start.
lootr.configuration.integrated_loot.tool: Options for adding loot from other loot tables to containers.
lootr.configuration.item_bans.tooltip: Options for items that must not appear in loot.
lootr.configuration.item_frames_self_sup: Lootr item frames do not pop off when the block they hang on is removed.
lootr.configuration.loot_modid_blacklist: Containers with loot tables of these mod IDs are not converted. Example: othermod
lootr.configuration.loot_table_blacklist: Containers with these loot tables are not converted. Example: modid:chests/loot_table
lootr.configuration.loot_table_forced_wh: Loot tables that are converted even if the loot table blacklist or the list of problematic loot tables contains them.
lootr.configuration.max_age.tooltip: Currently has no effect; kept so that existing configuration files stay valid.
lootr.configuration.max_extra_stacks.too: Upper limit of added stacks per container, whatever a rule asks for.
lootr.configuration.modded_item_weight.t: Draw weight of items from other mods; vanilla items weigh 1.
lootr.configuration.modid_dimension_blac: Containers are not converted in dimensions of these mod IDs. Example: othermod
lootr.configuration.modid_dimension_whit: Containers are only converted in dimensions of these mod IDs. Empty: all mod IDs. Example: minecraft
lootr.configuration.notification_delay.t: Notifications are only shown when a container has at most this many ticks left before it refreshes or decays (default: 30 seconds; -1: always).
lootr.configuration.perform_decay_while_: Containers already marked as decaying also decay while the level ticks, not only when they are next opened.
lootr.configuration.perform_piecewise_ch: Also check the pieces of a structure, not only its start, when deciding whether a position is inside it. More accurate, but may cost performance.
lootr.configuration.perform_refresh_whil: Containers already marked as refreshing also refresh while the level ticks, not only when they are next opened.
lootr.configuration.pinned_team_resolver: The team resolver to use. Only needed when several team add-ons provide teams with the same priority. Blank or unknown: 'lootr:default'.
lootr.configuration.power.tooltip: Options for comparators and redstone power.
lootr.configuration.power_comparators.to: If enabled, comparators read a signal of 1 from Lootr containers, otherwise 0.
lootr.configuration.randomise_seed.toolt: If enabled, every player gets differently rolled loot. If disabled, the seed of the container is used and all players get the same loot.
lootr.configuration.refresh.tooltip: Options for containers that refill with new loot.
lootr.configuration.refresh_all.tooltip: All containers refresh after they were opened for the first time, whatever the three lists say.
lootr.configuration.refresh_dimensions.t: Containers in these dimensions refresh. Example: minecraft:overworld
Containers with these loot tables refresh. Example: modid:chests/loot_table
lootr.configuration.refresh_modids.toolt: Containers with loot tables of these mod IDs refresh. Example: othermod
lootr.configuration.refresh_particles.to: Containers you have opened and that will refresh emit particles.
lootr.configuration.refresh_value.toolti: Ticks a refreshing container takes to refresh its contents (default: 20 minutes).
lootr.configuration.replace_when_decayed: A decayed container is replaced by its vanilla block instead of being removed.
lootr.configuration.report_unresolved_ta: Report Unresolved Loot Tables to Players
Unresolved loot tables are always logged. If enabled, players are also told when they open such a container.
lootr.configuration.respect_item_obliter: Treat items disabled by the mod Item Obliterator (if installed) as banned.
lootr.configuration.scrub_saved_inventor: Remove Banned Items From Saved Inventories
Remove banned items from already saved per-player inventories when they are accessed. This is permanent.
lootr.configuration.should_drop_player_l: A broken Lootr container drops the loot of the player who broke it (it is rolled first if needed).
lootr.configuration.skip_existing_items: Skip Items The Container Already Has
Do not add an item the container already yields.
lootr.configuration.skip_logging_no_loot: Skip Logging LootTable-less Block Entities during Generation
If enabled, no warning is logged when a container without a loot table is skipped during conversion.
lootr.configuration.skip_map_items.toolt: Do not create explorer maps (structure searches) for added loot.
lootr.configuration.start_decay_while_ti: Containers not yet marked as decaying are also marked while the level ticks, not only when they are opened.
lootr.configuration.start_refresh_while_: Containers not yet marked as refreshing are also marked while the level ticks, not only when they are opened.
lootr.configuration.team.tooltip: Options for sharing loot within a team.
lootr.configuration.team_loot.tooltip: If enabled, loot is assigned per team instead of per player. By default the scoreboard team counts; players without a team count on their own.
lootr.configuration.tick_delay.tooltip: Ticks between two checks of a container. The higher the value, the later containers notice that they should refresh or decay.
lootr.configuration.title: Lootr Remastered Configuration
lootr.configuration.trapped_custom.toolt: If enabled, custom inventories emit a redstone signal when opened, like trapped chests.
lootr.configuration.unopened_particles.t: Containers you have not opened yet emit particles.
lootr.configuration.vanilla_textures.too: Use vanilla textures instead of Lootr's own. Opened and unopened containers then look the same.
lootr.configuration.whitelist.tooltip: Lists that allow or block dimensions, loot tables and mod IDs.
lootr.message.cannot_break: Lootr blocks and entities cannot be broken or destroyed.
lootr.message.cannot_break_sneak: While in creative mode, you must sneak to break or destroy Lootr blocks and entities.
lootr.message.cannot_insert: Items cannot be inserted into Item Frames with Loot.
lootr.message.cart_should_sneak: Destroying this entity will prevent others from obtaining loot! Only destroy if really needed.
lootr.message.cart_should_sneak2: To destroy this entity anyway, sneak while attacking.
lootr.message.decay_in: This container will decay completely in %s seconds.
lootr.message.decay_start: The container begins to crumble at your touch! It will decay completely in %s seconds.
lootr.message.decayed: The decaying container crumbles at your touch!
lootr.message.emergency_conversion: The container you just opened has been converted into a Lootr container!
lootr.message.invalid_table: Error with mod [%s], not Lootr! The loot table for this container [%s] does not exist or could not be loaded. Please report this to the mod author, not to Lootr.
lootr.message.refresh_in: This container will refresh its contents in %s seconds.
lootr.message.refresh_start: The container will refresh with new contents in %s seconds!
lootr.message.refreshed: The contents of the container are refreshed at your touch!
lootr.message.should_sneak: Breaking this block will prevent others from obtaining loot! Only break if really needed.
lootr.message.should_sneak2: To break the block anyway, sneak while breaking.

lootr.configuration.personal_cycle.decay: The container decays for the player one interval after the last refresh. If off, the player keeps the last roll.
lootr.configuration.personal_cycle.enabl: Re-roll each player's loot of a container at fixed real-time intervals after their first opening, then let it decay for that player only.
lootr.configuration.personal_cycle.exclu: Dimensions where containers keep their loot for good: IDs or namespace:*.
Loot tables that keep their loot for good: IDs or namespace:* for a whole mod.
lootr.configuration.personal_cycle.overr: Schedules for single loot tables or mods: <table or namespace:*>=<hours>,<count>,<decay true|false>. An exact ID beats a namespace; malformed entries are logged and ignored.
lootr.configuration.personal_cycle.refre: How often a player's loot is re-rolled. 0 never re-rolls; the container then decays after the first interval.

Real hours between two re-rolls; server downtime counts. The schedule is computed from each player's start and the current values whenever they open, so changes (also by /reload) apply to running cycles.
lootr.configuration.personal_cycle.toolt: Per-player refresh and decay by real time. Containers that refresh or decay through the Refresh or Decay options are not affected.
lootr.cycle.message.decayed: This container has decayed for you.
lootr.cycle.message.refreshes_in: Refreshes for you in %s (%s of %s used)
lootr.cycle.reason.custom_inventory: custom inventories without a loot table keep their contents
lootr.cycle.reason.exempt_structure: it lies in a structure of the tag lootr:personal_cycle_exempt
lootr.cycle.reason.old_decay: Lootr's own decay applies to it
lootr.cycle.reason.old_refresh: Lootr's own refresh applies to it
lootr.cycle.reason.type: this kind of container cannot refresh
text.autoconfig.lootr.option.personal_cy: The container decays for the player one interval after the last refresh. If off, the player keeps the last roll.
Re-roll each player's loot of a container at fixed real-time intervals after their first opening, then let it decay for that player only.
Dimensions where containers keep their loot for good.
Loot tables that keep their loot for good; namespace:* covers a whole mod.
<table or namespace:*>=<hours>,<count>,<decay true|false>. An exact ID beats a namespace; malformed entries are logged and ignored.
How often a player's loot is re-rolled. 0 never re-rolls; the container then decays after the first interval.

Real hours between two re-rolls (at least 0.0167, one minute); server downtime counts. The schedule is computed from each player's start and the current values whenever they open, so changes apply to running cycles.
